purpose: Define the minimum behavior of a generic Contract Format 1.4 reader so an implementation can understand the canonical graph without AIGMos-specific filesystem or document-name heuristics.

topics.name: Generic Reader Profile
topics.purpose: Define the minimum behavior of a generic Contract Format 1.4 reader so an implementation can understand the canonical graph without AIGMos-specific filesystem or document-name heuristics.

semantics.identity_rule: Reader keys semantic nodes by canonical identity rather than path or display name.
semantics.ordering_rule: Reader does not assign meaning to key order or ordinary array order unless the owning field declares order semantics.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown extensions are preserved or reported according to extension policy; they are never silently reinterpreted.
semantics.prose_rule: Reader may surface prose but cannot depend on prose to reconstruct missing machine-significant semantics.
semantics.determinism_rule: Same accepted semantic graph yields semantically equivalent normalized reader output.

invariants.rule: Reading, writing, normalization, diffing, reconciliation and patching preserve canonical identity, ownership, Topic context and machine-significant semantics.

hard_gates.condition: reader collapses canonical identity into filename/display name
reader invents ordering from JSON object/array position
reader silently discards unknown machine-significant extension
reader depends on prose for missing machine semantics
